kept_items.author: AnthropicAI
kept_items.text: We've written an FAQ to answer some of the questions we've received about watermarking. In summary: We're implementing watermarking to comply with the EU AI Act. Other major model developers have signed the same Code of Practice and will also be implementing watermarking;
kept_items.selection_reason: Anthropic formally responds to the watermarking backlash covered on 11 and 12 August, attributing the change to EU AI Act compliance. Highest engagement item in the window.

kept_items.author: AnthropicAI
kept_items.text: As part of our Responsible Scaling Policy, we publish regular Risk Reports. These share detailed information on the risks of our systems and how prepared we are to address them. Our second Risk Report is now available.
kept_items.selection_reason: Second Responsible Scaling Policy risk report published; distinct story from the watermarking FAQ.

kept_items.author: TechCrunch
kept_items.text: Meta released Glimmer this week, an open-weight AI model anyone can download and run on their own hardware - a contrast to Muse Spark, the company's more powerful model that stays locked behind its own APIs.
kept_items.selection_reason: Trade press framing of Meta's split open-weight and closed model strategy.

kept_items.author: bearlyai
kept_items.text: Satya Nadella gave a talk on Microsoft's new AI strategy of building hill-climbing machines. Says if you're only a consumer of foundation models, how can you create enterprise value?
kept_items.selection_reason: Microsoft strategy statement with wide reach.

kept_items.author: omarsar0
kept_items.text: A 27B agent just beat Claude Opus 4.8 and GPT-5.5 on held-out research replication. Replica turns paper replication into a scalable RL task space.
kept_items.selection_reason: Concrete benchmark result for a small model against frontier systems.

kept_items.author: NVIDIAAI
kept_items.text: Meet NVIDIA NeMo Switchyard, a new open-source library for model routing. Use frontier models for complex reasoning and planning, and NVIDIA Nemotron Lightning for high-volume, specialized execution.
kept_items.selection_reason: Concrete open-source tooling release from NVIDIA.

kept_items.author: rohanpaul_ai
kept_items.text: New MIT paper introduces a new mathematical framework for representing, manipulating, and compiling deep learning architectures.
kept_items.selection_reason: Paper summary with a clear technical claim.

kept_items.author: rohanpaul_ai
kept_items.text: Meta's new paper: the dangerous failure mode is not just a wrong judge, but a correct judge that can be persuaded into becoming wrong.
kept_items.selection_reason: Distinct second item from same author covering LLM-as-judge robustness.

kept_items.author: fchollet
kept_items.text: Jeremy's excellent work here is a great illustration of a very powerful type of approach: LLM-guided on-the-fly synthesis of a symbolic world model, i.e. making sense of the world by writing executable code that encodes your understanding of the causal mechanics of the world.
kept_items.selection_reason: Named researcher articulating a technical approach; text explains the concept in its own terms.

kept_items.author: zhengyaojiang
kept_items.text: Had a look at Cordis, the theory behind DeepSeek Harness's plugin architecture. It's basically a theory that, as long as you follow a set of contracts for the components of a harness, there are theoretical guarantees that your harness can safely remove a component.
kept_items.selection_reason: Technical reading of the DeepSeek agent harness open-sourced the previous day.

kept_items.author: dongxi_nlp
kept_items.text: The SynthID-Text watermarking LLM generation is like: model forward pass -> next-token logits -> temperature / top-k / top-p -> keyed watermark probability update -> sample a token. For every plausible next token, Claude consults a secret, context-specific coin flip.
kept_items.selection_reason: Mechanistic explanation of the watermarking scheme under discussion.

kept_items.author: SlipperyGem
kept_items.text: Yet another open source video gen model has dropped! 114B6A, so not local until some quants drop.
kept_items.selection_reason: Concrete open-weight video model release with a named Hugging Face repository.

kept_items.author: WOLF_Financial
kept_items.text: Masayoshi Son said artificial superintelligence is 2 years away. The SoftBank CEO coined the term in a rare 2024 speech, defining ASI as AI 10,000 times smarter than humans. He said then it was 10 years off.
kept_items.selection_reason: Named executive making a dated, revisable forecast.

kept_items.author: FT
kept_items.text: OpenAI upheaval mounts as Sam Altman readies IPO push
kept_items.selection_reason: Newspaper report on OpenAI corporate turmoil ahead of a listing.
